title: Align MCP instructions and delta attachment behavior
objective: Inject MCP server instructions in a way that matches the original prompt behavior while minimizing prompt cache churn.
context: The original adds MCP server instructions when connected servers provide them, unless the delta attachment path is enabled.
Late MCP connection changes can otherwise break prompt cache.
Go has MCP tools and skill integration but no clearly equivalent system prompt instruction section.
deliverables: Collect instructions from connected MCP servers.
Render a '# MCP Server Instructions' prompt section equivalent to the original.
Add a delta attachment path or minimal equivalent that avoids rewriting static prompt sections on late connection.
Ensure empty or disconnected MCP servers do not produce prompt noise.
Add tests for no instructions, one server, multiple servers, and late connection.
acceptance: MCP instructions are visible to the model when present.
The prompt does not include empty MCP sections.
Late MCP changes avoid rebuilding static system prompt content when the delta path is enabled.
non_goals: Do not add new MCP protocol features.
Do not change MCP tool execution schemas.
Do not implement UI for MCP configuration.
handoff_notes: Prefer adding a small prompt-facing MCP instructions interface over coupling prompt code to MCP transport internals.
